claims.text: Machine-learning predictive modeling can accurately determine melting temperatures across the high-entropy-alloy family.
Machine-learning predictive modeling can accurately determine enthalpies of fusion across the high-entropy-alloy family.
Machine-learning predictive modeling can accurately determine entropies of fusion across the high-entropy-alloy family.
Machine-learning predictive modeling can accurately determine volume changes at melting across the high-entropy-alloy family.
Machine-learning predictive modeling can accurately determine liquid-phase thermodynamic properties across the high-entropy-alloy family.
Machine-learning predictive modeling can determine these thermodynamic properties efficiently.
Existing thermodynamic-property data contain patterns that can mediate prediction of high-entropy-alloy behavior.
Machine-learning algorithms can use patterns in existing data to predict thermodynamic properties.
The approach will improve predictive accuracy relative to prior experimental and theoretical methods.
The approach will improve efficiency relative to prior experimental and theoretical methods.
The predicted accuracy will be at least 95%.
Prior experimental and theoretical methods have limited accuracy.
Prior experimental and theoretical methods have limited efficiency.
The approach is applicable across the high-entropy-alloy family.
The approach may have limited performance in extremely complex or novel alloy systems.
Limited training data or high model complexity can increase uncertainty in model performance.
